hints.title: Middle Element Anchoring
hints.text: Anchor the middle index j. We need the maximum profits[i] where i < j and prices[i] < prices[j], and the maximum profits[k] where k > j and prices[k] > prices[j].

hints.title: Prefix and Suffix Binary Indexed Trees
hints.text: Maintain a Fenwick tree (Binary Indexed Tree) for prefix maximums over price values to find the best left profit.

hints.title: Suffix Sweep
hints.text: Scan from right to left with a second Fenwick tree (querying prices > prices[j]) to find the best right profit.

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Two sweeps using Fenwick trees querying range maximum profits.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: O(n^2) nested scans exceed time limits for n = 10^5.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Use Fenwick tree or coordinate-compressed segment tree for prefix/suffix point updates.
